shots.prompt: Rae dances alone in a dark studio full of haze, wearing one pair of Nocturne headphones on her head over her ears, nothing around her neck. She spins in slow motion, platinum hair flying, cut out by one hard white backlight through the haze and a blue rim light. Cinematic, high contrast. Deep bass thumps. No text.

Night rooftop in light rain with blurred city lights and soft neon glow far behind, no signs and no lettering anywhere. Rae, wearing one pair of Nocturne headphones on her head, nothing around her neck, hits sharp dance moves to the beat, hoodie and hair whipping, raindrops catching the neon light. Slow motion, cinematic, wet reflections. Rain and bass. No text.

Nocturne headphones turn slowly in mid-air in a dark void as a hard copper light sweeps across the ear cups and the brushed copper rings flare, fine haze drifting through the beam. Cinematic product film. A deep synth swell. No text.

Extreme close-up of a young woman with a sharp platinum blonde bob and dark winged eyeliner, Rae, in the dark, eyes closed, wearing one pair of wireless Nocturne headphones on her head over her ears, no cables, bare neck with nothing around it, a strobe light flashing hard white across her face, she snaps her head to the beat and her hair swings. Cinematic, high contrast. Muffled bass. No text.

Wide shot: Rae lands a powerful dance move in a dark empty concrete tunnel lit by a row of hard white strobe lights, one pair of Nocturne headphones on her head and nothing around her neck, dust bursting up in the light. Cinematic, slow motion, high contrast. A bass hit echoes. No text.
